content.value: An array stores a fixed number of values of one element type. Declare with brackets, allocate with new, or use an initializer. Indices begin at zero. The length field is not a method. New numeric elements are zero, boolean elements false, and reference elements null. An array reference may itself be null.
This prints 3 then 10. The array keeps its length after assignment. scores[3] would be out of bounds. String[] names = new String[3] creates three null references, not three String objects.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
